name: input
title: Input
description: A native text input in three sizes with icons, addons, a floating label, clear and password buttons, plus a one-time code. CSS-only motion.

.rx-input-filled.background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--field-shade), transparent 40%) padding-box, linear-gradient(var(--_bg), var(--_bg)) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, var(--field-edge-top), var(--field-edge-bottom)) border-box

.rx-input-action.transition: background-color 150ms var(--motion-ease), color 150ms var(--motion-ease), opacity 150ms var(--motion-ease), visibility 150ms, scale var(--spring-swap-duration) var(--spring-swap)

.rx-input-reveal svg.transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), scale 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), filter 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)

.rx-input-label.transition: translate var(--spring-label-duration) var(--spring-label), scale var(--spring-label-duration) var(--spring-label), color 150ms var(--motion-ease)
